# Startup in a Box — live demo

> A dual-screen, multi-agent live demo by Martin Brian. You type a startup idea;
> two agent frameworks conspire and ship a real Next.js app to a real Vercel URL,
> live on stage. One screen is a boardroom (Google ADK), the other a factory
> (Claude Agent SDK).

This page (https://startupinabox.martinbrian.com) is the demo's front end.

## How it works

- Boardroom (Google ADK): a CEO agent runs seven specialists and produces a typed Lean Canvas + BuildPlan.
- Factory (Claude Agent SDK): a supervisor delegates to five subagents and doesn't stop until the DevOps agent deploys to Vercel.
- The two are wired with the AG-UI protocol; one typed POST connects planning to building.

## Notes for agents

This is a live, interactive demo, not static content. The architecture and
write-up live in the GitHub repo's README and docs/diagrams.
